terra.problem: The explanation puts the sword behind the scattered hair. God says He will unleash a sword behind the scattered people (Ezekiel 5:12).
The strands do not start the fire; they are thrown into an existing fire. God says a fire will spread from there.
The second third is slashed all around the city. The instruction does not mention the city walls.
The explanation suggests the fire spreads through Ezekiel's garment. The text says a few strands are taken from it and thrown into the fire, not that the garment burns.
“I'll keep it simple” comments on how Papa Dorin tells the passage.
“I'll let the verse speak” comments on how Papa Dorin tells the passage.
Calling the alternative a nicer verse makes the wording of Scripture the subject of a comparison, rather than treating it reverently.
